title: Cross-material cross-regime Richards falsification
question: Does the derivative-consistent adaptive hydraulic representation preserve Richards fidelity and the analytical nonlinear path across materially distinct soils and wet-to-dry hydraulic states?
forcing_policy: For each case the fixed top flux is set from the authoritative analytical initial conductivity, matching the controlled F-AHL04A construction; bottom mode remains prescribed head.
representation: F-AHL09 derivative-consistent cubic-Hermite z=logit(Se) retention, C obtained from the same interpolant derivative, log(K) linear lookup, exact authoritative handling for h>-1 cm.
